detours.why: D-666 ARM B: this B.Cu segment TERMINATES at the barrel (59.300,106.300) the same spec removes.  Relaying it between its own two ends asks the router to reach a site that is reserved and a bond that is gone; ARM A asked exactly that and got NO_PATH at 0.300 mm inside a 5.180 mm budget.  It is a stub of a removed bond, so it is REMOVED AND NOT PUT BACK and the gate's inert_removal_priced clause prices it.

note: D-666: /WAKE_INT_N's LAST edge, {U2.1,U3.1} <-> {Q10.3,R3.1,U1.23}, 25.258 mm.  Five of the six pairings are NO_PATH at 0.050 mm; the sixth, U2.1 <-> Q10.3, is OPEN and WORTHLESS -- maze3d.offcentre_route closes it with NOTHING evicted in 151.580 mm across FIFTEEN barrels (evidence/d666-wake-last-edge-pairings.json), the same answer route_join called TOO_LONG in D-665 section 7 and the tap census priced at 150.169 mm in D-665 section 1.  screen_pair_corridor_blame.py at margin 1.0, --minimise-only --per-object --max-mm 50 (evidence/d666-blame-wake-u2-q10-m10-min.json) prices the opening: Q1's upper bound over all 32 window nets is 29.955 mm / 2 vias, Q3's MINIMAL SET is 3 nets {/IR_TX_GPIO16, /SX1262_CS_N, GND} opening at 35.546 mm, and Q4's MINIMAL OBJECTS is EIGHT physical units / 34 router objects opening at 35.407 mm on B/I2/F/I2/B/F with 5 vias at (53.100,92.100), (54.050,96.800), (57.550,100.050), (59.200,106.400) and (55.800,107.850).  /ACC_5V_SW_EN is IN the window and Q3 offered it back and kept it: this opening does NOT touch the protected switched-5V accessory enable.  (1) THREE contiguous F.Cu segments of /IR_TX_GPIO16 -- the IR transmit drive, unprotected -- run straight across the corridor at y=108.0 and are RELAID between the chain's own ends.  (2) TWO contiguous F.Cu segments of /SX1262_CS_N -- the LoRa chip select, unprotected -- likewise.  (3) ONE B.Cu GND segment and the TWO GND barrels at (59.300,106.300) and (59.900,106.500) stand exactly where the fourth via must land; the barrels are REMOVED AND NOT MOVED and the re-bond is owed to --repair-planes on the POST board, D-665 section 4.  Reserve discs hold the two via sites the relays could otherwise re-block.  ARM B (D-666): the GND stub is relay:false and the reserve discs are 0.500 mm, not 0.650 -- ARM A's 0.650 mm disc at (55.800,107.850) straddles /IR_TX_GPIO16's own y=108.0 run and its relay came back NO_PATH inside a 9.220 mm budget.
